editorial.blurb: Kyuramen x TBaar is a modern Japanese ramen spot in downtown Chicago where stylish booth seating and attentive service make every visit feel like an experience, not just a quick meal.
editorial.insiderTip: Go later in the evening for quick seating and service — one reviewer was seated and served their full order (including drinks and food) remarkably fast on a Friday night, and Valentine's Day walk-ins scored bar seats.

topDishes.note: fantastic value with ramen, appetizers, drinks, and desserts
